name: Germany

eSignLaw.name: eIDAS Regulation and German Civil Code

levelNote: A simple electronic signature meets text form (section 126b). Where German law requires written form, only a qualified electronic signature or a handwritten one will do (sections 126 and 126a).

formRequirements.note: Section 766 BGB excludes electronic form for a suretyship declaration.
A will must be handwritten or made before a notary.
Property sales need a notary (section 311b BGB).

notices: Electronic signature law that applies: eIDAS Regulation and German Civil Code. A simple electronic signature meets text form (section 126b). Where German law requires written form, only a qualified electronic signature or a handwritten one will do (sections 126 and 126a).
You must be at least 18 years old to sign this agreement.
If these terms are standard terms, German law (sections 305 and following BGB) requires them to be clear and understandable; ask for a German copy if you need one.
If you are unsure whether this applies to you, ask for a paper alternative before signing.
limitationNote: Regular period: three years from the end of the year the claimant knew (section 195 BGB); outer caps are longer.
